requirement: The current project purpose remains the bounded audit of evidence for an experimental ML claim, not a universal model-ranking claim.
authoritative_basis: roadmap.md §1; stage_01_project_scope.md §§3-8; NIST AI RMF MAP 1.1 and MANAGE 1.1
pass_rule: Purpose, scope, exclusions, and claim boundary agree in all current sources.
fail_rule: Any current source asserts a broader or conflicting purpose.
blocked_rule: A required current source is missing or cannot be interpreted without an owner decision.

requirement: Stages 1-7 and their accepted outcomes are traceable to the present project state.
authoritative_basis: ISO/IEC/IEEE 15288:2023; NASA NPR 7123.1D Chapter 5
pass_rule: Every stage has an identifiable objective, disposition, and current evidence link with no unresolved contradiction.
fail_rule: At least one stage lacks a disposition/evidence link or contradicts the current state.
blocked_rule: A required historical decision cannot be recovered from registered evidence.

requirement: Deferred outputs such as CLI, dashboard, bilingual documentation, and public repository are classified as required, optional, deferred, or out of current scope by John-approved criteria.
authoritative_basis: ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148:2018; NIST requirements verification characteristics
pass_rule: Each named output has one unambiguous disposition and acceptance consequence.
fail_rule: An output is silently treated as complete, irrelevant, or required without a registered disposition.
blocked_rule: John ownership or intended MVP boundary is materially ambiguous.

requirement: The canonical chain claim to protocol/config to execution evidence to verdict is complete and path-valid.
authoritative_basis: NIST AI RMF MEASURE; National Academies reproducibility guidance
pass_rule: All mandatory chain elements exist, resolve, and preserve the registered bounded interpretation.
fail_rule: Any mandatory element is missing, points to an obsolete artifact, or changes verdict meaning.
blocked_rule: A necessary provenance link cannot be established from registered files.

requirement: Registered seeds, split geometry, metric direction, schemas, rounding semantics, verdict policy, and canonical numeric artifacts remain internally consistent.
authoritative_basis: NIST AI RMF MEASURE; NIST SP 500-234
pass_rule: All registered invariants and protected hashes pass exact or contract-defined validation.
fail_rule: Any registered invariant is violated or an unexplained scientific artifact mismatch exists.
blocked_rule: The original environment/provenance is insufficient for a required exact comparison and no valid disposition exists.

requirement: Public scientific language states the observed scope, uncertainty, limitations, and computational-cost disclosure without converting local evidence into universal superiority.
authoritative_basis: NIST AI RMF MAP and MEASURE; Stage 6 public-claim contract
pass_rule: Every public-facing current formulation includes the required bounded scope and disclosures.
fail_rule: A current formulation omits a mandatory limitation or implies universal superiority.
blocked_rule: No authoritative current public formulation has yet been designated.

requirement: Critical Stage 5 computation and verdict-policy logic has a supported modular implementation, while notebooks remain thin orchestration.
pass_rule: All critical registered operations map to module contracts and orchestration cells contain no unapproved top-level implementation.
fail_rule: Critical logic remains notebook-only or a supported contract is absent.
blocked_rule: Criticality or ownership of a discovered helper is materially ambiguous.

requirement: Syntax, schemas, notebooks, deterministic fixtures, negative mutations, historical regressions, and cumulative pilot pass without weakened requirements.
authoritative_basis: NIST IR 8397; NIST SP 500-234
pass_rule: The registered baseline, focused checks, and full cumulative pilot all return PASS with no FAIL/BLOCKED.
fail_rule: Any required check returns FAIL or a requirement was weakened to obtain PASS.
blocked_rule: A required check cannot execute because a prerequisite is unavailable.

requirement: The supported software interface and unsupported research-only interfaces are explicitly distinguished.
authoritative_basis: ISO/IEC 25010:2023; ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148:2018
pass_rule: Every externally described interface is implemented, tested, and labelled supported; research-only interfaces are labelled accordingly.
fail_rule: An externally described interface is absent, untested, or conflicts with its implementation.
blocked_rule: The intended supported interface requires a John scope decision.

requirement: A fresh qualified environment can be reconstructed from versioned dependency and Python constraints.
authoritative_basis: National Academies reproducibility guidance; Python Packaging User Guide
pass_rule: A declared environment specification installs in a clean environment and reports compatible registered versions.
fail_rule: No usable specification exists or clean reconstruction fails for an in-scope reason.
blocked_rule: Required package infrastructure or offline dependency material is unavailable.

requirement: A documented command reproduces the supported smoke or audit path with registered inputs and no hidden network dependency.
authoritative_basis: National Academies reproducibility guidance; NIST SSDF PS.3
pass_rule: The documented command succeeds from a clean copy using declared inputs and produces contract-valid outputs.
fail_rule: The command is absent, fails, uses undeclared inputs, or silently requires network access.
blocked_rule: An authorized expensive run or unavailable external resource is indispensable.

requirement: Canonical artifacts, checkpoints, environment, numeric backend, and source provenance are integrity-bound and independently checkable.
authoritative_basis: NIST SSDF PS.2 and PS.3; NASA requirements traceability practice
pass_rule: Required hashes, provenance fields, archive inventory, uniqueness, and exclusions validate exactly.
fail_rule: A required hash/provenance mismatch, duplicate, omission, or forbidden cache artifact exists.
blocked_rule: An external checkpoint required by a registered gate is inaccessible.

requirement: A root entry document identifies purpose, bounded claim, prerequisites, supported workflow, evidence, limitations, and status.
authoritative_basis: ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148:2018; ISO/IEC 25010:2023
pass_rule: A current root entry document contains all mandatory sections with valid paths.
fail_rule: The document is absent, materially incomplete, misleading, or references obsolete paths.
blocked_rule: John has not selected the intended external audience or language policy where that changes content.

requirement: Installation, verification, reproduction, and troubleshooting instructions are executable and mutually consistent.
pass_rule: Every required instruction is complete and its command succeeds in the declared context.
fail_rule: A mandatory instruction is absent, contradictory, or fails when followed.
blocked_rule: Execution depends on an unavailable prerequisite outside the authorized environment.

requirement: Current normative documentation is separated from historical records and uses exact repository-relative paths and bounded terminology.
authoritative_basis: ISO/IEC/IEEE 15289 linkage from ISO/IEC/IEEE 15288:2023; ML-CRA working contract
pass_rule: All current paths resolve, historical material is labelled, and normative/current statements do not conflict.
fail_rule: A broken current path, unlabeled historical assertion, or normative contradiction exists.
blocked_rule: The owner must resolve two equally authoritative but conflicting decisions.

requirement: If ML-CRA is to be distributed as a Python package, standardized build and project metadata explicitly define name, version, Python requirement, dependencies, and package contents; otherwise distribution is explicitly not claimed.
authoritative_basis: Python Packaging User Guide pyproject.toml specification
pass_rule: Either valid standardized metadata builds the intended package or current documentation explicitly limits the project to a non-distributed research snapshot.
fail_rule: Distribution is claimed without valid metadata/build, or metadata omits a mandatory declared property.
blocked_rule: John has not decided whether Python-package distribution is a current release target.

requirement: Any claimed distribution artifact installs into a clean environment and imports/runs the supported interface.
authoritative_basis: Python Packaging User Guide packaging flow; ISO/IEC 25040:2024
pass_rule: A freshly built artifact installs and its supported smoke command passes without workspace leakage.
fail_rule: A claimed artifact cannot be built, installed, imported, or executed as documented.
blocked_rule: No distribution artifact is required because John approved a non-distributed release class.

requirement: Release inventory excludes environments, caches, temporary/candidate outputs, secrets, and unregistered local analytics while including every required artifact.
authoritative_basis: NIST SSDF PS.2 and PS.3; ML-CRA checkpoint rules
pass_rule: Inventory is unique, complete, hash-bound, and contains no forbidden or secret-bearing file.
fail_rule: A required file is missing or a forbidden, duplicate, temporary, or secret-bearing file is present.
blocked_rule: The intended release class and corresponding required inventory are not yet approved.

requirement: The repository has an explicit John-approved license consistent with any open-source claim, or it explicitly states that redistribution rights are not granted.
authoritative_basis: GitHub Docs licensing a repository; Python Packaging User Guide licensing guidance
pass_rule: License text and metadata are present and consistent, or the approved non-open status is explicit.
fail_rule: Open-source or redistribution is claimed without a compatible license, or license declarations conflict.
blocked_rule: Only John can choose the project license or non-open distribution policy.

requirement: Dataset source, license/terms, citation, and redistribution constraints are documented for every externally distributed data-related artifact.
authoritative_basis: OpenML terms/metadata; Stage 2 dataset admission contract
pass_rule: Every included dataset-derived artifact has traceable source/terms and an allowed distribution disposition.
fail_rule: An included artifact lacks provenance/terms or violates a documented distribution constraint.
blocked_rule: The authoritative dataset license or redistribution permission cannot be established.

requirement: Software and scientific outputs have machine-readable citation metadata or an explicitly approved alternative citation instruction.
authoritative_basis: Citation File Format 1.2.0 documentation; FORCE11 software citation principles
pass_rule: Citation metadata validates and identifies creators, title, version/status, and preferred citation, or an approved alternative is complete.
fail_rule: External scientific release is claimed without usable citation metadata/instructions.
blocked_rule: Creator identity, preferred citation, or release identifier requires John input.

requirement: Release-relevant security risks, dependency risks, secrets, and provenance controls are assessed with recorded dispositions.
authoritative_basis: NIST SP 800-218 SSDF; NIST IR 8397
pass_rule: Applicable checks pass and every finding has an accepted disposition or bounded non-release classification.
fail_rule: An unmitigated release-blocking finding exists or a required control is absent.
blocked_rule: A necessary scanner/advisory source is unavailable and risk cannot be bounded locally.

requirement: All FAIL, BLOCKED, SKIPPED, deferred outputs, known limitations, and residual risks are registered with owner and disposition before a release decision.
authoritative_basis: NASA NPR 7123.1D review completion; NIST AI RMF MANAGE
pass_rule: No finding is silent; every non-PASS item has severity, owner, consequence, and accepted disposition/plan.
fail_rule: A release-blocking item is unresolved or an observed finding is omitted.
blocked_rule: A required disposition is reserved for John and has not been provided.

requirement: Project completion and release readiness are decided separately by an explicit fail-closed aggregation and John acceptance.
authoritative_basis: NIST AI RMF MANAGE 1.1; NASA NPR 7123.1D §5.2.3; ISO/IEC 25040:2024
pass_rule: All dimension and aggregate verdicts recompute exactly and John separately accepts any transition/release decision.
fail_rule: An aggregate is overstated, dimensions are conflated, or release proceeds without John decision.
blocked_rule: One or more mandatory requirements is BLOCKED/NOT_EVALUATED or John decision is pending.
